headline: Fuel prices this weekend. Drivers face cuts from Saturday; here is what we will pay today
summary: From Saturday through Monday, 95-octane petrol costs no more than 6.73 zł per litre, 98-octane 7.59 zł and diesel 7.88 zł. The limits follow Friday's announcement by the Minister of Energy.
why: Retail fuel prices feed directly into inflation, transport costs and household spending, so government price measures are closely watched by investors in Poland's economy.
